title: Every new binary Carlitz exact-conductor component is supersingular
statement: For every exact conductor level j, every Frobenius eigenvalue on the new cohomology of K_(t^(j+1))/K_(t^j) is sqrt(2) times a root of unity. THIS PROPOSITION IS FALSE; exact level ten supplies a trace-divisibility counterexample.

formal.statement: {"claim":"all exact-conductor Carlitz Frobenius eigenvalues are sqrt(2) times roots of unity","counterexample":{"degree":22,"level":10,"remainder":1024,"required_divisor":2048,"trace":-5120},"field_order":2,"format":"axeyum-gf2-carlitz-supersingularity-divisibility","version":1}

evidence.supports: At level 10 and degree 22 the exact trace is -5120, whose magnitude has remainder 1024 modulo the necessary supersingular divisor 2048.
evidence.notes: The exact conductor trace is reconstructed from native Hayes class populations. If all eigenvalues were sqrt(2) times roots of unity, their degree-22 powers would be 2^11 times roots of unity; the rational integral trace would therefore be divisible by 2^11. The nonzero remainder refutes the universal claim.

provenance.source: native exact-conductor Hayes trace and algebraic-integer divisibility

notes: This refutes only a blanket supersingular decomposition of every new conductor component. It does not refute a smaller Heisenberg subquotient, a non-supersingular commutator-rank estimate, or the connected top-trace conjecture.
